title: Downloads
actionFailedReveal: Could not show {{title}} in its folder
actionFailedNext: Could not move {{title}} to the front of the queue
notFoundHint: This download no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
redownloadQueuedMany_one: {{count}} episode of {{title}} is queued to download again
redownloadQueuedMany_other: {{count}} episodes of {{title}} are queued to download again
waitingForSlot: Starts when a slot frees up
waitingForPlayback: Waits until playback from this source stops
waitingForConnection: Waits for a free connection on this source
waitingForConnectionAt: The provider has no free connection. Trying again at {{time}}
waitingForProvider: Can't reach the provider. Trying again at {{time}}
pausedHint: Paused. The partial file is kept.
failedHint: The download stopped with an error
folderChanged: New downloads will be saved to the chosen folder
folderChangeFailed: Could not change the downloads folder
folderOpenFailed: Could not open the downloads folder
clearConfirmBody: Failed and canceled downloads are removed from the queue, along with any partial files.
cancelConfirmBody: {{title}} stops downloading. You can retry it later from Needs attention.
deletePartialHint: Frees the disk space. When off, the partial file stays in the downloads folder.
queueEmptyBody: Use the download button on a movie or episode to save it for offline viewing.
queueEmptyWithLibrary_one: Your {{count, number}} finished download is in My videos.
queueEmptyWithLibrary_other: Your {{count, number}} finished downloads are in My videos.
shortcutPause: Pause or resume the focused download
shortcutReveal: Show the focused download in its folder
libraryEmptyBody: Finished downloads appear here and play without a connection.
fileMissingBody: It was moved or deleted outside the app. Download it again or remove it from the library.
removeLibraryKeepBody: {{title}} leaves the library. The file stays on disk.
removeLibraryDeleteBody: {{title}} leaves the library and its file is deleted from disk.
alsoDeleteFileHint: Frees the disk space. This cannot be undone.
detailNotFoundTitle: This video is not in your library
detailNotFoundBody: It may have been removed. Check My videos or the download queue.
favoritesEmptyBody: Add channels, movies, and series from any source to your favorites to collect them here.
favoritesEmptySourceBody: Add channels, movies, and series in this source to your favorites to collect them here.
reorderFailed: Could not save the new order
recentEmptyBody: Channels, movies, and episodes you open show up here.
clearHistoryBody: History from every source and your recent searches are removed. Favorites and resume points stay.
clearHistorySourceBody: History from {{source}} is removed. Favorites and resume points stay.
sourceRemovedHint: The source for this item was removed. Add it again to open the item.
emptyNoSourcesBody: Add a source first. Channels, movies and series you add to your favorites then show up here.
recentNoSourcesBody: Add a source first. Channels, movies and episodes you open then show up here.
scheduledEmptyBody: Open the TV guide and choose Remind me, Record or Record series on a programme.
scheduledServerNoMpv: Recording is unavailable because the server has no mpv. Reminders still work.
scheduledPadding: Starts {{before}} min early, ends {{after}} min late
recordingsEmptyBody: Recordings from the player and the TV guide show up here.
recErrorEngineMissing: Recording this stream needs mpv. Install mpv or set its path in the player settings.
recErrorMissedNotRunning: The app was not running when this recording was due.
recErrorStoppedShutdown: Stopped early because the app was closing.
recErrorClosedEarly: Stopped early because the app closed while recording.
recErrorClosedNothing: The app closed before anything was recorded.
recErrorSourceRemoved: The source of this channel was removed.
recErrorStreamDropped: Stopped early because the stream kept dropping.
recErrorStreamGaps: The stream dropped during the recording, so parts of the programme may be missing.
recErrorStreamNotFound: The channel's stream address no longer exists. Refresh the source, then schedule the recording again.
recErrorStreamRejected: The provider refused the stream. Check that the subscription is active and not already using all of its connections.
recErrorStreamNoAnswer: The provider's server did not answer. Check the internet connection and that the server is online.
recErrorStreamServerError: The provider's server is busy or down. Try again later.
recErrorNotAStream: The channel's address answered with a web page, not a video stream. Refresh the source, then schedule the recording again.
recErrorDiskFull: The disk is full. Free some space or choose another recordings folder in Settings.
recErrorRuleRemoved: Cancelled because its series rule was removed.
stopConfirmBody: Recording of {{title}} stops now and cannot be resumed. What was recorded so far stays in My videos.
scheduledPaddingAll: Recordings start {{before}} min early and end {{after}} min late
